method.non_reference_text: Exact extracted text after removing ONLY one expected old/new global folio; no whitespace, word, number or clinical-content normalization
method.non_reference_raster: Pixel equality at 72dpi on the full width above the bottom25point global folio margin
method.reference_text: All authored main p/td/h2/h3 >=25normalized characters; NFKC alphanumerics
method.consent_text: Complete case-sensitive old/new PDF text after whitespace/soft-hyphen/Unicode ligature normalization; source casefold for CSS transforms
method.qr: Actual PNG and 3x rasterized guide/card QRs decoded using zxing-cpp; exact regimen knowledge URL; live route access not established

handbook_layout_page_changes.note: Freshly rendered reference pages use installed Liberation/Noto fonts versus previous Nimbus/DejaVu fonts. Reference raster equivalence is neither asserted nor expected. All original six non-reference sections are independently exact in body text/raster.

all_short_reference_blocks_check.method: Every nonempty authored main p/td/h2/h3 shorter than25normalizedcharacters checked against the full normalized reference body, in addition to the established long-block checks.
